text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Hokko Tarumae received a fan letter.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Tarumae-chan, you're doing amazing in Tokyo! I always believed you'd become famous, so as a fan, I couldn't be happier!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I saw your live performance online,
and the crowd went wild! It was so moving!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even though she said she didn't really get the internet...
She's still following everything I do.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Back when I was active in my hometown, this person's connections got me invited to perform at the shopping district's events!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Back before I became the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador,
when I was a local idol and didn't know my left from my right—

text_block_list.name: Local Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, the lottery is underway~!
We've got a special stage performance today, so come on over and watch~!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I'll start from here...
I'm gonna hone my skills to promote Tomakomai!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I look forward to working with you!
I'll sing with all my might to hype everyone up...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You chose me, even without any drawing power.
And to this day, you still send me fan letters—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! For the sake of all the people supporting me,
I need to promote Tomakomai even more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae refocused her resolve,
raising high expectations for her even greater leap forward.
